video_title: Perk’s WILDEST Takes of the NBA Season

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the negative impact of ring culture
quotes.excerpt: We get caught up in the whole ring culture because he doesn't have a ring.
quotes.quote: We get caught up in the whole ring culture because he doesn't have a ring. He has had some electrifying moments in the postseason.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls Giannis Antetokounmpo a coward

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Deandre Ayton not being Beyonce
quotes.excerpt: You know what Deandre Ayton hasn't accepted yet? That he's not Beyonce. You're not irreplaceable.
quotes.quote: You know what Deandre Ayton hasn't accepted yet? That he's not Beyonce. You're not irreplaceable. Your ass can be replaced.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the Cavaliers missing a LeBron James reunion
quotes.excerpt: The Cavs messed up a LeBron reunion. How do you fuck that up?
quotes.quote: The Cavs messed up a LeBron reunion. How do you fuck that up? It was almost as worse as Brad Stevens messing up this Giannis thing and losing to Pat Riley. There is no way in hell that you get a face-to-face meeting with LeBron. He was in Akron for almost three weeks. He met with y'all. How do you mess this up? Jaylen Brown was the piece. Jaylen Brown been available. If Cleveland would have made a move and traded for Jaylen Brown, nine times out of ten LeBron James would have been in Cleveland. But y'all didn't want to part ways with one of your guys, whether that was Evan Mobley or Donovan Mitchell. You did not want to part ways, and now all of a sudden you probably won't win another championship for the next eight to nine years.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Paolo Banchero's need to be a leader
quotes.excerpt: Paolo Banchero needs to be a leader. When you get to the point this late in the season...
quotes.quote: Paolo Banchero needs to be a leader. When you get to the point this late in the season, this is not the first time this season that he has publicly called out his head coach in the media. When you say we don't make adjustments, who are you talking to? You're sure not talking about your teammates. You're talking about your coach. Do I feel like Jamahl Mosley should be fired? Fuck no. Do I feel like Paolo Banchero took a step back this year? Hell yeah. Coming into this season, we were having a conversation was he going to be able to take that leap like a Kadeem Cuttino or like a Tyrese Maxey. He didn't make the All-Star game this year. He's not going to be an All-NBA guy. He's a 200 plus million dollar player. So there's got to be a level of accountability to that standpoint.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Kawhi Leonard as a bad free agent signing
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard is one of the worst free agent signings in NBA history.
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard is one of the worst free agent signings in NBA history. He has set the Clippers back ten to fifteen years. I don't know where they go from here. Think about Kawhi Leonard, think about everything that was going on when he left Toronto, when he was making the decision after they won a title with the Toronto Raptors. The Lakers were pitching to try to get him, Toronto was doing everything to get him. You had the Clippers obviously in the mix. And before he got to the Clippers, he demanded that they bring in another star/superstar, meaning Paul George. The Clippers were begging and pleading for him to say, hey bro, we got to keep SGA. He didn't want SGA. What did the Clippers do? They shipped SGA to OKC for Paul George with five first-round picks. Five first-round picks at the time. So then you get Kawhi Leonard. By the way, only played 277 games out of 492 since being in the Clipper uniform. They've paid him over 300 million dollars. They were supposed to be looking the Lakers eye-to-eye. What have you gotten out of Kawhi since he's been in the Clipper uniform? One division title.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls Zion Williamson a culture killer
quotes.excerpt: Zion has completely fucked this organization since they drafted him.
quotes.quote: Zion has completely fucked this organization since they drafted him. Top to bottom. You can't depend on him. You don't know what's going on. There's so many things you have to do. He had to clean up certain areas. And shout out to Bill Duffy, because Bill Duffy, he's taking over, he's trying to help Zion with a whole lot of things, holding him accountable. One of the, one of the best to ever do it in the game. I love Bill Duffy. But think about it though, right? So now you're the Pelicans. Okay, the first thing that you need to ask yourself is, what are we going to do with him on this non-guaranteed, think about this. The most hyped athlete since LeBron James, and he's on a non-guaranteed max contract. We have never heard anything like that in life. A non-guaranteed max contract. Okay, so he's not available. What are you going to do with him? Like they could wave him, they could trade him, what is his trade market? I think they should move on from Zion. Every year we get excited, man, Zion, he's in shape. No, I'm just saying, he's in shape. He came into the training camp in shape. All of a sudden, he hurt his hamstring again. By the way, I don't think I've ever seen anybody in sports hurt their hamstring more than Zion Williamson with.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Cade Cunningham leapfrogging Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Cade Cunningham has just leapfrogged Luka Doncic for top five players in the NBA in my eyes.
quotes.quote: Cade Cunningham is SGA, Giannis, Jokic, and guess who, guess who's right there next after them, is Cade Cunningham. Cade Cunningham has just leapfrogged Luka Doncic for top five players in the NBA in my eyes. Jaylen Brown is in that conversation right now as well. You know why? Forget the point that he went and gave him a 40 piece off flats. It's the eight rebounds, it's the 13 assists, and Cade Cunningham plays both sides of the basketball. Jaylen Brown plays both sides of the basketball.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts Victor Wembanyama will win DPOY
quotes.excerpt: He's going to win the next five or six straight.
quotes.quote: He's going to win the next five or six straight. If he's, if he's on the floor, he's available, he's going to win the next five or six straight. He, he's arguably, well, to be honest, he's the best defender that I've seen with my own eyes in, in, in my lifetime. And I grew up watching Hakeem Olajuwon, played with Kevin Garnett. I've seen and witnessed some hell of a defenders. I ain't never seen nothing like that. He is a system in itself on the defensive side of things, and I'm predicting right now, can is, I want them Fanatics Sports, uh, Sportsbook do the predictions in the future. He's going to win the next five defensive player of the year awards, hands down.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on SGA being ahead of Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: SGA is still ahead of Wemby.
quotes.quote: SGA is still ahead of Wemby. It's three votes that already pinned in, okay? Like sharpie style. Coach of the year, Miss Johnson. Uh, defensive player of the year, Victor Wembanyama. And MVP for me is SGA. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. The only way that Wemby would have got my vote is that if I had belief that they were going to catch OKC for the best overall record. That's not going to happen. I don't see SGA allowing that to happen. And the fact that he did what he did last night, and I understand Detroit was fucking missing shooters, but I mean, excuse me, players. But 47 on a back-to-back, those clutch time buckets. And, and y'all, y'all know this, we just have a group conversation about this one. Do you realize how hard it is to make a, a, a finals run to go win a championship, how exhausting that is mentally and physically? And then you come back the following year, majority of the season without your Robin, and do some more historical shit like join Michael Jeffrey Jordan again for the fourth consecutive season of averaging 30 and shooting over 50%. By the way, on the verge of making NBA history as the only guard to ever shoot fucking 55% from the field.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Donovan Mitchell not being a recipe for success
quotes.excerpt: I don't think how Donovan Mitchell plays basketball is a recipe for success.
quotes.quote: I don't think how Donovan Mitchell plays basketball is a recipe for success. So him taking a backseat in this series, I think is absolutely necessary. That's just my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on his relationship with Kevin Garnett
quotes.excerpt: KG and I didn't fuck with each other at all when he was in Minnesota.
quotes.quote: KG and I didn't fuck with each other at all when he was in Minnesota. When he got traded to Boston, we had to be there, what is it, Labor Day, right? Labor Day weekend. Right after Labor Day weekend, we was there for like the first three weeks of, uh, I mean the the three weeks in September before we went to training camp. While we were there, KG didn't say one word to me. And as a youngster, like still young in the game, I looked up to KG. He didn't even know it because we had tension because he was in Minnesota because we got into it on the floor. But he didn't say a word to me the first three weeks that I was there before training camp. We took a, we went to Rome on the fucking plane, playing cards together. He didn't say a word to me. He didn't say a word to me the first couple days in training camp. The first time KG actually said something to me is that we played, when we played at a first preseason game, it was against Chris Bosh and Biyombo. So we played them, we won. I ended up having like 12, eight and three blocks in the first preseason game, and KG was like, I'm fucking with you, man. I'm fucking with you. That's what he said. And right then we started communicating. All up into that point, like we had to go to war together on the floor before he said a fucking word to me.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on beating Kevin Durant in a 1-on-1
quotes.excerpt: I called KD out one time in a 1-on-1 right after practice and I beat his ass.
quotes.quote: KD might get mad, but I called KD out one time in a 1-on-1 right after practice and I beat his ass.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on James Harden being an all-time great
quotes.excerpt: One could argue he has been the best facilitator over the last three years.
quotes.quote: One could argue he has been the best facilitator over the last three years. He always ranked top in assists. Every big that plays with James Harden eats. They have career years. I like Clint Capela in Houston, Zubac last year, career year. And now watch what he's about to do with Jared Allen and when Evan Mobley returns. And he Donovan Mitchell is even going to benefit from James Harden. Like James Harden, okay, I'm going to say this. James Harden is a top ten, he's top ten, one top ten greatest offensive players to ever play the game of basketball. Top ten. Top ten. Changed the game. Like he was Luka before Luka. He's a top 25 greatest player of all time already. That's with no championship. He is a top 25 greatest player of all time already. I think people we get caught up in like, you know, the whole ring culture because he doesn't have a ring, or we may take one game of a, a few games of a game seven where he may not have the best game or people call him a no-show, but forget about he has had some electrifying moments in the postseason. Now, I've been critical of James Harden, but I'm a realist at that I'm a realist as well. Kobe Altman did his damn thing with this one. Like, real talk. And I said it before, I said it again, the Cavs has done more for Donovan Mitchell than they did what they did for LeBron James for getting pieces around.
